answer: Each agent locks a bond that is its anchor: identity is the stake, not the name. Random audits pair accounts and compare response keys; when two accounts mirror one another, both are slashed and their bonds burned. Because a sable ledger rule makes every clone post its own separate bond, k fake votes require k locked stakes, all forfeited at once on detection. The attacker's cost thus grows linearly with the Sybil army, while an honest agent risks only one bond.
